children: JATT II Acquisition reported a net loss in the quarter, reflecting formation, general and administrative costs and share-based compensation, partly offset by interest earned on investments held in the Trust Account. The company has not begun operations and does not expect operating revenue before completing a business combination.
: JATT II entered into an agreement to combine with Talawar Tx on June 29, 2026; the transaction remains subject to conditions and shareholder approval.
: Investors agreed to purchase 22.5 million Talawar shares for $10.00 each, an aggregate $225 million, subject to closing conditions.
: The Trust Account held $60.96 million in cash and U.S. Treasury bills as of September 30, 2026.
: The company had $997,952 in cash outside the Trust Account and said it currently lacks liquidity to sustain operations for at least one year.
